title: Taylor Marsh
body_html:
Summary

Primary user of the LTS pipeline, in the Beacon Systems Navigators.

Details

  • Involvement: Primary user of the solution. He and the Beacon Systems Navigators own the LTS release problem the program solves, and they take over running the pipeline at handover.
  • Sign-off: Gives a final sign-off before the sponsor, Shay Chandler.
  • Go to them for: What the LTS process needs to do in practice, whether a result solves their problem, acceptance.
